classification.difficultyReason: Find all determinable sectors by combining local sums and parallel-line facts across three figures.

content.prompt: Calculate as many angles as you can in these diagrams. You do not need to show reasoning.

spec.description: A–B–E is straight. BC and ED extend down-left with matching downward parallel markers. EF extends down-right. The square at E marks the complete BEF angle; ED divides it and DEF is labelled 60 degrees. There are no additional joining segments.
spec.mathematics: BEF=90 degrees, DEF=60 degrees and BC is parallel to ED. BED=30 degrees, ABC=30 degrees and CBE=150 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 60 degrees and right-angle square are visible.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle BED+60^\circ&=90^\circ\\\angle BED&=30^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles in a right angle.

$\angle ABC=30^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).

$$\begin{align*}\angle CBE+30^\circ&=180^\circ\\\angle CBE&=150^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on a straight line.

spec.description: A–B–E–G is a gently descending straight transversal; C–B–D is a steeper straight line. EF extends down from E without an upper extension. Upward-pointing markers establish BD parallel to EF. FEG is labelled 70 degrees.
spec.mathematics: FEG=70 degrees. Corresponding and vertically opposite angles give DBE=ABC=70 degrees. CBE, ABD and BEF are each 110 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied 70-degree label is visible.

answer.worked:
$\angle DBE=70^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).

$\angle ABC=70^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

$$\begin{align*}\angle CBE+70^\circ&=180^\circ\\\angle CBE&=110^\circ\\\angle ABD+70^\circ&=180^\circ\\\angle ABD&=110^\circ\\\angle BEF+70^\circ&=180^\circ\\\angle BEF&=110^\circ\end{align*}$$
Angles on straight lines.

spec.description: Triangle ABD has A above B and D to the right. DC descends leftward from D. Upward parallel markers identify BA and CD. The 70-degree label is at A inside BAD; the 60-degree label is at D inside ADB. No BC segment is drawn.
spec.mathematics: BAD=70 degrees and ADB=60 degrees. AB is parallel to CD. The coordinates realize both triangle angles and parallelism. Co-interior angles give ADC=110 degrees; subtracting ADB gives BDC=50 degrees; alternate angles give ABD=50 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied 70-degree and 60-degree labels are visible.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\angle ADC+70^\circ&=180^\circ\\\angle ADC&=110^\circ\end{align*}$$
Co-interior angles between parallel lines.

$$\begin{align*}\angle BDC+60^\circ&=110^\circ\\\angle BDC&=50^\circ\end{align*}$$
Adjacent angles forming $\angle ADC$.

$\angle ABD=50^\circ$ (alternate angles on parallel lines).
